**What would you like to do?**
Describe what you're trying to achieve and why the current tool makes it hard.

**How might it work?**
Your idea, if you have one. Sketches and examples from other tools are welcome.

**Anything else?**
Remember that chop chop runs entirely in the browser and never sends data anywhere, so ideas that need a server or external services are out of scope.
